entries.title: I Chronicles 1:1
segments: Adam, Seth, Enos,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:2
segments: Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:3
segments: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:4
segments: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:5
segments: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:6
segments: And the sons of Gomer were Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:7
segments: And the sons of Javan were Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:8
segments: The sons of Ham were Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:9
segments: And the sons of Cush were Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:10
segments: And Cush fathered Nimrod. He began to be mighty on the earth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:11
segments: And Mizraim fathered Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:12
segments: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines), and Caphthorim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:13
segments: And Canaan fathered Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:14
segments: the Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:15
segments: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:16
segments: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:17
segments: The sons of Shem were Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:18
segments: And Arphaxad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:19
segments: And to Eber were born two sons. The name of the one [was] Peleg (because in his days the earth was divided), and the name of his brother [was] Joktan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:20
segments: And Joktan fathered Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazar-maveth, and Jerah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:21
segments: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:22
segments: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:23
segments: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:24
segments: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:25
segments: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:26
segments: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:27
segments: Abram (the same [is] Abraham).

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:28
segments: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:29
segments: These [are] their generations. The first-born of Ishmael was Nebaioth, and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:30
segments: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:31
segments: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These [are] the sons of Ishmael.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:32
segments: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: She bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:33
segments: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these [are] the sons of Keturah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:34
segments: And Abraham fathered Isaac. The sons of Isaac [were] Esau and Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:35
segments: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:36
segments: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:37
segments: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:38
segments: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:39
segments: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. And Timna [was] Lotan's sister.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:40
segments: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:41
segments: The son of Anah [was] Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:42
segments: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:43
segments: And these [are] the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before a king reigned over the sons of Israel: Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:44
segments: And Bela died; and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:45
segments: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:46
segments: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city [was] Avith.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:47
segments: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:48
segments: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:49
segments: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:50
segments: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place. And the name of his city [was] Pai. And his wife's name [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:51
segments: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom: chief Timnah, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:52
segments: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:53
segments: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

entries.title: I Chronicles 1:54
segments: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These [are] the chiefs of Edom.
